title: Separable elements in a geometrically irreducible extension
statement: Let $K/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. Then $K/k$ is geometrically irreducible [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] if and only if every element of $K$ that is separably algebraic over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] belongs to $k$.

proof.text: For a separably algebraic element α of K, let E = k(α). Mathlib's isSeparable_adjoin_iff_isSeparable makes E/k separable directly from separability of α; no relative separable closure is required. The simple-adjoin finiteDimensional lemma [lem-weil-pbc-simple-algebraic-extension-power-basis] makes E/k finite. Apply the injective-subalgebra clause of [lem-zl-geometric-irreducibility-subalgebra-colimit] to E → K to descend geometric irreducibility to E/k.

source.place: Tag 0G33 proof, equivalence (1) and (2); Mathlib and the proved universal-homeomorphism API implement the indicated steps

proof.text: Every intermediate field F of E/k is separable over k by Algebra.IsSeparable.of_algHom. Choose a transcendence basis of F/k; separability up the tower makes F separable over the intermediate field it generates. This verifies [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension]. Set Ω = AlgebraicClosure E, which is algebraically closed and a k-algebra. Apply [lem-pc-separable-tensor-algebraic-closure] to identify E ⊗[k] Ω with the product of Ω indexed by k-embeddings E → Ω. The affine pullback isomorphism transfers geometric irreducibility to irreducibility of the spectrum of this product.

source.place: Tag 0G33 proof, equivalence (1) and (2); Mathlib and the proved universal-homeomorphism API implement the indicated steps

proof.text: By [lem-zl-spectrum-irreducible-nilradical-prime], the product ring has prime nilradical. If distinct embedding indices i and j existed, let e be 1 at i and 0 elsewhere. Then e(1-e)=0, so e or 1-e is nilpotent. Evaluation at i, respectively j, would make 1 nilpotent in Ω, a contradiction. Thus the embedding type is subsingleton. Mathlib's isPurelyInseparable_iff_subsingleton_emb makes E/k purely inseparable. Since E/k is also separable, surjective_algebraMap_of_isSeparable gives surjectivity k → E, so α lies in k.

source.place: Tag 0G33 proof, equivalence (1) and (2); Mathlib and the proved universal-homeomorphism API implement the indicated steps

proof.text: Conversely, let A be the algebraic closure of k in K [def-weil-relative-algebraic-closure]. If x in K is algebraic over A, it is integral over A; since A is integral over k, Mathlib's isIntegral_trans makes x integral over k and hence an element of A. Apply [lem-zl-field-extension-algebraically-closed-geometric] to deduce geometric irreducibility of K/A. No explicit finite coefficient field or products of bases are needed.

source.place: Tag 0G33 proof, equivalence (1) and (2); Mathlib and the proved universal-homeomorphism API implement the indicated steps

proof.text: Every element of A is integral over k. If it is separable over k, its image in K is separable by IsSeparable.map, so the hypothesis puts it in the image of k. The defining Mathlib criterion isPurelyInseparable_iff for [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension] therefore makes A/k purely inseparable; the separable-first decomposition is unnecessary.

source.place: Tag 0G33 proof, equivalence (1) and (2); Mathlib and the proved universal-homeomorphism API implement the indicated steps

proof.text: The proved library instance [lem-pc-spec-pure-insep-integral-radicial-surjective] makes Spec A → Spec k integral, universally injective and surjective, hence a universal homeomorphism. Its base changes are homeomorphisms by [lem-pc-integral-radicial-surjective-universal-homeomorphism]. In particular every field base change has source homeomorphic to the one-point spectrum of the field, so A/k is geometrically irreducible. This uses the existing purely inseparable instance directly, without the general power-generated spectrum theorem or a characteristic split.

source.place: Tag 0G33 proof, equivalence (1) and (2); Mathlib and the proved universal-homeomorphism API implement the indicated steps

proof.text: Apply Mathlib's GeometricallyIrreducible.comp [lem-zl-geometric-irreducibility-transitive] to Spec K → Spec A → Spec k. The universally open instances are inferred for morphisms to spectra of fields. Functoriality of Spec and IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq identify the composite with the structure morphism Spec K → Spec k.

split_report.summary: Split the Tag 0G33 equivalence into the two implications. The forward implication passes to the finite separable field generated by one element, uses the subalgebra clause of the Tag 037N node and the existing finite-separable tensor decomposition over an algebraic closure, and concludes from irreducibility of a finite product. The converse uses the algebraic-closure-in-extension criterion (Tag 037P) for the algebraic closure of k in K, the separable-first decomposition (Tag 030K) to see that this closure is purely inseparable over k, the Tag 0BRA universal-homeomorphism node to get its geometric irreducibility, and transitivity (Tag 0G30). Maintainer review (2026-10-18) added the citations for the finiteness and separability of k(alpha), for the algebraic closure being a subfield and algebraically closed in K (transitivity of algebraicity written out), and the characteristic-0 case of Step 5.
